proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13551.1 sūcī gives Prakrit sūī, Gujarati soy, regional suv/suvva and Nepali siyo (explicitly remodeled by the verb sew), alongside sūiya. Selected western hvi/hoi/hoy/hõi and suvi/swi retain s/h weakening and glide/vowel notation; Nepal-area siyo/śuyo/śuⁱye/śuiyo and sūīā retain the remodeled or extended endings. These are qualified regional family matches, not exact quotations of every source form. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: hoy.
